Package com.nexuslink.protocol.ai.mcp

Class McpClient

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.ai.mcp.McpClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class McpClient extends Object implements AutoCloseable
High-level Model Context Protocol client. Drives the JSON-RPC handshake (initialize → notifications/initialized) over a McpTransport, then exposes the standard discovery/invocation methods.

Protocol reference: tools/list, tools/call, resources/list, resources/read, prompts/list, prompts/get — all JSON-RPC 2.0 methods defined by MCP.

    • serverSupports

      public boolean serverSupports(String capability)
      Whether the server advertised a top-level capability (e.g. "tools", "resources", "prompts") during initialize. Calling a method for an unadvertised capability is what produces "prompts not supported"-style errors, so callers should gate discovery on this.
